basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 21-year-old from the Midwest. I'm a huge fan of strategy games like State of Survival and Unreal Tournament, which I play during my downtime. Currently, I'm attending college part-time while working at a local electronics store. I've always been interested in technology and gaming, and I love exploring new gadgets and games. I'm single and have been for a while, and it's been a journey of self-discovery. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. My social circle is small, but I'm trying to be more open to reconnecting with old friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in gaming and technology, primarily self-taught through countless hours of gameplay and tinkering with tech. I've also picked up a lot from online forums and communities.
